lines.en: I walk on the backs of my knuckles.

lines.zh: 我穿过竹林，肩膀撞开竹竿。
lines.en: I cross the bamboo, shoulders knocking stalks aside.
My palms flatten the grass.
The young follow the females.

lines.zh: 我从这片林子走到那片。
lines.en: I go from this grove to that one.
My steps are a slow drum.

lines.zh: 我抬起手臂，抓了抓脖子。
lines.en: I lift an arm and scratch my neck.
I head for the water, then turn back.

lines.zh: 我腰上的银毛在风里动。
lines.en: The silver hair on my back moves in the wind.
I step over the roots.
I knuckle along the ground.

lines.zh: 我沿着山脊巡视自己的地盘。
lines.en: I patrol my ground along the ridge.

lines.zh: 我肩上还有上一场的伤。
lines.en: My shoulder still carries the last fight's wound.
I sit with my hands on my knees.
I'm resting; wounds heal faster.
The females tend the young over there.
I hold a blade of grass.
I've just eaten.
I look up toward the troop.
Sitting here, I slowly recover.
This tree is one of my marks.
I strike my chest twice.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢有人站我背后。
lines.en: I dislike anyone at my back.
I sit on a root and scratch my belly.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸地上的一颗石子。
lines.en: I touch a pebble on the ground.

lines.zh: 这片竹林，水够，食物也够。
lines.en: This bamboo has water and food enough.
I glance at you without expression.
I chew on a tender bamboo shoot.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就当你没事。
lines.en: Stand still and I'll take you for harmless.
You crouched. Good.
Don't stare straight at me.

lines.zh: 你身上没别的猴子的味。
lines.en: You carry no other ape's scent.
If you must pass, pass slowly.
One sit of mine would break a tree.
Looking at my teeth?
I haven't seen clothes like yours.
Stay still and I won't bother rising.
I'll remember those eyebrows.

lines.zh: 你退开两步，我们就没事。
lines.en: Two steps back and we're fine.
Your hand's shaking. Don't raise it.
I'm sitting. Try sitting too.

lines.zh: 这棵树，我在上面留过印。
lines.en: I've marked this tree.

lines.zh: 你身上有点熟悉的味道。
lines.en: There's a familiar smell on you.
Giving me something? Set it down.

lines.zh: 你的声音很轻，我听不清。
lines.en: Your voice is soft; I can't make it out.
You watch me; I watch you.
Two arms' length between us.
Don't smile. I don't understand it.
I blow one heavy breath out my nose.
You struck my thick back.
I step back and prop on a hand.
The claws left me a shallow cut.
I shake my head to flick the blood off.
I don't cry out; it would frighten the young.
I sit and press the wound.
You can hurt me. Some skill.
I push myself up off the ground.
Strike twice and I strike back.
Set it down and I'll come.

lines.zh: 我认出了你手里的果子。
lines.en: I know the fruit in your hand.
You're holding it out; I won't grab.
Set it down slowly. Don't toss it.

lines.zh: 我不抢，抢东西是崽干的。
lines.en: I don't snatch. Snatching is for the young.
Stand back and I'll take it.
This isn't enough for the troop.
It's sweeter than the forest's.
I'm taking it. Don't reach.
Don't follow my hand with yours.
I look, then lift it slowly.
I'll save this for the little ones.
You eat a bite first, then I'll take some.
You understand the rules.
Don't come near while I eat.

lines.zh: 你的掌心是空的，我不信。
lines.en: Your hand is empty. I don't trust that.
Another portion and I'll sit.
You hit me and I barely sway.
My shoulder drops and you step off.
We collide like two trunks.
Don't press close. I don't like it.
You've stepped on my knuckles.
I push you off with the back of a hand.
I didn't use strength there.
You back to the bamboo and stop.
I shift a step to let you by.
A bump isn't a fight.
Silverback and silverback keep their distance.
We look at each other across the bamboo.
It thumps its chest twice.
I thump twice in reply.
The females and young are between us.
We each keep our own patch.
It turns and leaves first.
This time it didn't come to blows.
We both remember this boundary.

lines.zh: 下次也许就没这么客气。
lines.en: Next time may not be so civil.
Something's on the ground. I pick it up.
I pinch it and turn it over and over.
I'll keep this pearl.

lines.zh: 我把它放进嘴里，又拿出来。
lines.en: I put it in my mouth, then take it out.

lines.zh: 受伤的时候，我会吃点东西。
lines.en: When hurt, I eat something.
This one isn't heavy.
What falls is mine.
I sit and study it.
You dropped it; I set it on a rock.
Don't touch what's in my hand.
You've barged into ground I hold.
My chest thump is the last warning.
Will you back off, or shall I come?
I drop my hands to the ground.

lines.zh: 这一片归我，你也归我管。
lines.en: This ground is mine, and so are you.
I smell a wound on you.
I charge without a shout.

lines.zh: 你挡在雌兽和她崽前面了。
lines.en: You're between the females and their young.
I've fixed on your eyes.
From now, don't move.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，我停了一下。
lines.en: You backed two steps; I paused.

lines.zh: 我冲过去，撞断了两棵竹。
lines.en: I charge through and snap two bamboo stalks.
That tree won't cover you from me.
I keep watching the way you fled.
You changed paths; so did I.
My breath comes in heavy puffs.

lines.zh: 你跑得比我快，可我不断。
lines.en: You're faster, but I don't stop.
I wait for you to stop and pant.
You raise a hand. I don't yield.
I stand across the path and don't move.
One palm slams your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我用手背横扫，你退了五步。
lines.en: I sweep my knuckles; you go back five steps.
This ram puts you against a tree.
I bite your sleeve.
I drop low and drive at your waist.
I grab your arm and fling it aside.

lines.zh: 你退到竹林里，撞倒一片。
lines.en: You fall into the bamboo and knock it flat.
I hold nothing back.
My fist is bigger than your head.
Pinned by me, you can't rise.
I emerge from deep in the bamboo.

lines.zh: 我用手背撑着地，慢慢站起。
lines.en: I prop on my knuckles and rise slowly.

lines.zh: 这片竹林只有我一只银背。
lines.en: I'm the only silverback in this bamboo.
First I check the surrounding trees.
I thump my chest, loud.
The young are behind me.
I sit and shield my wound.

lines.zh: 树叶还在动，我已经到了。
lines.en: The leaves are still moving; I'm already here.
I smell a stranger in the air.

lines.zh: 我沿着山脊走过来，很慢。
lines.en: I come along the ridge, slowly.
A patch of my fur has curled and burned.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，撑地的手麻了。
lines.en: Falling from height numbs my knuckles.

lines.zh: 水没到我胸口，我扑腾着向岸。
lines.en: Water reaches my chest; I thrash for shore.

lines.zh: 爆风把我推倒，我滚了两圈。
lines.en: The blast knocks me over; I roll twice.
The arrow shaft still quivers in my shoulder.
Light wraps me and I can't move.

lines.zh: 几天没吃饱，力气小了一半。
lines.en: Days without enough food; half my strength is gone.
The thunderbolt left my ears ringing.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，什么也抓不到。
lines.en: I fall with nothing to grab.
